message.content: Tesla has not officially launched the Model S (or any other vehicle) in India yet, so there’s no published retail price. Once it does enter the market, the cost will likely be significantly higher than the U.S. price because of import duties, GST, and local taxes—probably in the range of ₹1–2 crore—but until an official announcement comes out, the exact figure isn’t known.
